site_description: The umbrella home for restoring and maintaining classic Rogue and its direct descendants — BSD Rogue 3.x, 4.x, 5.x, Advanced Rogue, Super-Rogue, UltraRogue, XRogue, Rog-O-Matic, and friends. Source archaeology, recovered binaries, modern ports, and documentation.

groups.summary: Per-game pages: history, recovered binaries, source releases, restoration status, guides.

groups.summary: Yendor's Guide, the Vade-Mecum, manual pages, internals.

groups.title: History & provenance
groups.summary: Where each version was rescued from — BSD CSRG distributions, FTP archives, personal mailings, the SourceForge era.
